content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

When platforms like Gumroad impose a 10% fee on every sale, digital creators lose a significant portion of their revenue. In contrast, using NOWPayments only incurs a 0.5% fee. This difference means that on 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921. Such savings can be reinvested into your business, allowing you to grow without the constraints placed by traditional payment systems. This infrastructure ensures your earnings are maximized while facilitating a seamless customer experience.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your Bitcoin payment infrastructure, gather the essential tools: a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic service such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a reliable order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. You also need NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin transactions. This stack is not just functional; it is designed to give you full ownership of your digital store while eliminating dependency on platforms that restrict your earnings.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by integrating NOWPayments into your chosen backend logic service. This step enables you to accept Bitcoin payments directly. Next, configure your order storage to keep track of customer purchases. You can automate product delivery through Google Drive for file hosting and Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, ensuring that customers receive their ebooks instantly upon confirmation of payment. This streamlined process is crucial for maintaining customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
Retain more revenue by avoiding hefty platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Test the payment pipeline by processing a transaction yourself to ensure everything works smoothly. After successful testing, promote your ebook on your digital platforms, directing traffic to your new store URL. Monitor the first few transactions closely to address any issues quickly. This proactive approach helps build trust with your customers and ensures a robust operation from the outset.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your system is operational, focus on scaling your offerings. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that streamline your scaling process. You can add more products like courses or templates, optimize marketing strategies, and enhance customer engagement. Leverage the low transaction fees and high retention rates to expand your digital product range without the burden of high platform fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by setting up your own infrastructure using Bitcoin. Utilize NOWPayments for payment processing, which incurs a low 0.5% fee, ensuring you retain more profits. This approach provides complete control and ownership of your sales process, eliminating reliance on restrictive platforms.
Automate delivery for a seamless customer experience.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider a Complete Builder Kit ($197) that includes all necessary blueprints and templates for building your own sovereign stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options and take control of your digital commerce.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. It requires no KYC and no buyer account, ensuring a hassle-free experience for your customers. This service is ideal for creators in regions where traditional payment methods are restricted.
How can I ensure my ebooks are delivered instantly?

By integrating Google Drive with your order management system, you can automate product delivery. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to send download links to customers immediately after payment confirmation, ensuring a seamless purchasing experience.
Can I sell other digital products using the same infrastructure?

Absolutely. This infrastructure is versatile and can support various digital products, including courses, templates, and software. Just load additional products into your setup and use the same payment processing system to manage all sales.
What if I need help setting this up?

Consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides comprehensive documentation and templates to help you deploy and scale your infrastructure efficiently. It covers everything you need for a successful launch.
How can I market my ebooks effectively?

Leverage social media, email marketing, and SEO strategies to promote your ebooks. Share valuable content related to your products to engage potential customers and direct them to your store, ensuring a steady flow of traffic.
